name: Smart Model Routing
description: Picks the model for each turn instead of sending everything to one: cheap work goes to a cheap model and hard work goes to a strong one, so quality holds without paying top-tier rates for every message.
tagline: Send each turn to the model that fits it

definition.note: On/off switch over the gateway's classifier-driven smart routing. The model_map and ordered rules stay owned by GET/PUT /v1/config; enabling this plugin forces smart_routing.enabled on at the next gateway restart.

permission_levels.label: Can view routing
permission_levels.description: See which model each kind of request is routed to.

permission_levels.label: Can change routing
permission_levels.description: Change which models requests are routed to, affecting cost and quality for everyone.
